content: निभृत {%a.%} .²1 Placed down, deposited, lowered. .²2 Filled with, full of; चिन्तया निभृतः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 32. 20</ls>. .²3 Concealed, hidden, out of sight, unperceived, unobserved; निभृतो भूत्वा <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; नभसा निभृतेन्दुना <ls>R. 8. 15</ls> ‘with the moon become invisible, about to set or go down’; <ls>Ve. 6. 2</ls>; <ls>Śi. 6. 20</ls>. .²4 Secret, covert; अणुदीर्णवर्णनिभृतार्थमाह्वयत् <ls>Śi. 13. 42</ls>. .²5 .³({%a%}) Still, silent; निभृतद्विरेफम् (काननम्) <ls>Ku. 3. 42</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">6. 2</ls>. .³({%b%}) Steady, fixed, immovable, motionless; निष्कम्पचामरशिखा निभृतोर्ध्वकर्णाः <ls>Ś. 1. 8</ls>. .²6 Mild, gentle; अनिभृता वायवः <ls>Ki. 13. 66</ls> ‘not gentle, violent or strong’; <ls>Māl. 2. 12</ls>; <ls>Mv. 3. 14</ls>; स्वजननिभृतः सर्वोऽप्येवं मृदुः परिभूयते <ls>Pratimā 1. 18</ls>. .²7 Modest, humble; अनिमृतकरेषु प्रियेषु <ls>Me. 70</ls>; प्रणामनिभृता कुलवधूरिव <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; वधनिमृतसिंहाश्च गिरयः <ls>Pañch. 1. 3</ls>; अद्यप्रभृति निभृता भवन्ति <ls n="Pañch. 1.">2</ls>; युक्तं चतुर्भिर्निभृतैस्तुरङ्गैः (रथम्) <ls>Bu. Ch. 3. 8</ls>. .²8 Firm, resolute. .²9 Lonely, solitary; (निभृतनिकुञ्जगृहं गतया) <ls>Gīt. 2</ls>. .²10 Shut, closed (as a door). .²11 True, faithful, firmly attached. .²12 Inactive (निष्क्रिय, त्यक्तोद्योग); निभृता नरेन्द्राः <ls>Rām. 4. 28. 43</ls>. .{@-ता@} A kind of riddle; <ls>Kāv.</ls> .{@-तम्@} Modesty, humility. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Secretly, covertly, privately, unperceived; <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 74</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 263</ls>. .²2 Silently, quietly; <ls>K. 134</ls>. .²3 Out of sight, in a corner.
